funding.name: Alaska Performance Scholarship (APS)
funding.provides: The Alaska Performance Scholarship is awarded at three levels based on high school GPA and ACT, SAT or WorkKeys scores, for students who complete rigorous high school courses.
funding.eligibility: High school GPA of 3.5 (Level 1), 3.0 (Level 2) or 2.5 (Level 3), with the matching ACT, SAT or WorkKeys score; complete specific rigorous high school courses
funding.amount: Up to $7,000 per year (Level 1), up to $5,250 per year (Level 2), up to $3,500 per year (Level 3)

funding.name: University of Alaska financial aid (Pell, grants, work-study, scholarships)
funding.provides: University of Alaska financial aid includes need-based aid such as the Pell Grant, supplemental grants and work-study, determined by the FAFSA, plus separate loans and merit-based scholarships.
funding.eligibility: Need-based aid is based on financial need as determined by the FAFSA
funding.how_to_apply: Fill out the FAFSA, then apply to a University of Alaska campus
